question: Who among the following is associated with the Tabla?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Alla Rakha Khan__**​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alla Rakha Khan** was a renowned **Tabla Player__**__ __specializing in **__Hindustani Classical Music__.**
 
• His notable work is **__Ragmala__.**
 
• **Awards-**Padma Shree(1977), Sangeet Natak Academy(1982)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

**Pannala Ghosh**

__
 
• **Pannalal Ghosh **is acknowledged as the **Pioneer **__of **__Hindustani Classical Flute Music__.**
 
• He was a disciple of **Ustad Allauddin Khan.**
 
• He was a great composer and created new **Ragas such **as **Chandramauli, Jayant, Kumari, Nupur- Dhwani , **etc.

**Ronu Mazumdar**

__
 
• He too is a great Indian **Flautist.**
 
• Awarded by **Sangeet Natak Academy__**(2014)

**Doreswami Iyenger**

__
 
• He was a **Carnatic Musician__**__ __and one of the greatest **Exponents of Veena**.
 
• **Awards-** Padma Bhushan(1983), Sangeet Kalanidhi(1984) of the Madras Music Academy 

**Tabla**

 
• **Tabla **is a small drum or ** Pair of Drums **tuned to different pitches playing with hands.
 
• The right side is called the **Tabla ****and **the left**, the Bayan **or **Dagga.**
 
• ** **It is type of **Avanaddha vadya** or **Membranophones**​
